We have invested in the provision of learning facilities within our tea and coffee operations.
Though collaboration with our key buyers, we have invested in early childhood education at our
coffee operations and offer support to learning institutions through donations of learning material
to schools around our coffee estates. Our Tea division maintains nursery and primary schools
providing free education to the children of employees, dependents, and surrounding communities.
The group supports education through bursaries and stipends while also providing funds to
